bead.welcome.app-ai-detail: Your assistant workspace and ongoing conversations. Uses your existing accounts.
bead.welcome.app-brain-detail: Browse and search your private notes, knowledge and memories.
bead.welcome.app-colors-detail: Explore the real colors in a wallpaper. Compare modes, preview, then apply or export.
bead.welcome.app-settings-detail: Set up your desktop, displays, connections and everyday preferences.
bead.welcome.apps-intro: Tools for longer tasks, with quick controls always close by in the shell.
bead.welcome.apps-note: AI and Brain are optional. Welcome uses what is already installed; it does not set up accounts or download models.
bead.welcome.colors-intro: Your desktop colors come from your wallpaper. Try a wallpaper and a style to see the colors they give your desktop.
bead.welcome.colors-more: Compare every style and apply your choice in Nacre Colors.
bead.welcome.demo-note: This is a preview. Nothing changes on your desktop until you apply colors in Nacre Colors.
bead.welcome.guide-ai-detail: Nacre AI is optional. It connects your existing Codex or Claude installation to your work. You choose the provider and sign in with your own account.
bead.welcome.guide-ai-setup: In this developer build, follow ai/README.md in the Nacre project checkout for component setup. If it is already installed, the Nacre AI page in Settings manages its existing setup.
bead.welcome.guide-ai-status: Optional development component. Install with --with ai; provider sign-in and models remain your choice.
bead.welcome.guide-brain-detail: Nacre Brain is optional. It gives your private notes and memories a searchable home on your computer.
bead.welcome.guide-brain-setup: In this developer build, follow docs/features/nacre-brain.md in the Nacre project checkout for the vault and knowledge-service setup. Keep your existing notes outside the desktop repository.
bead.welcome.guide-brain-status: Optional development component. Install with --with brain; Welcome never creates or moves your vault.
bead.welcome.help-about: Nacre is a desktop for Hyprland and niri, built with Bead. System packages stay with your distribution; personal configuration stays on this computer.
bead.welcome.help-attention-detail: Open Maintenance in Settings for health checks, updates, releases and recovery. Save your work before restarting or restoring.
bead.welcome.help-comfort-detail: Settings has display scaling and a reduced-motion option. Sound, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth controls also open their detailed pages.
bead.welcome.help-panel-detail: Press Escape to dismiss a launcher or wallpaper picker. Unpin the AI sidebar if you want it to close when you leave.
bead.welcome.help-panel-title: A panel is in the way
bead.welcome.help-terms-detail: Welcome stays in the launcher, and you can open it whenever you need it.
bead.welcome.help-title: A little guidance, when you need it
bead.welcome.hero-tagline: Mother-of-pearl. Colors shaped by your wallpaper.
bead.welcome.hero-tour: A short tour of your desktop
bead.welcome.ready-note: Your choices are saved. Reopen Welcome from the launcher whenever you like.
bead.welcome.shortcuts-intro: Your current shortcuts. Scroll to explore.
bead.welcome.shortcuts-note: Super is usually the Windows key.

bead.welcome.title: Nacre Welcome
